admission.role: Closer analysis internal to the retained ordinary-j2 branch

frobenius_concentration.m_zero_plus_fibre: c_p=0 for all sufficiently large primes p=7 mod 8
frobenius_concentration.m_zero_minus_fibre: c_p=2 for all sufficiently large primes p=3 mod 8

fixed_target_dichotomy.equivalence: c_p=a modulo p iff p divides N_(m,epsilon)(a), for p not dividing 2v
fixed_target_dichotomy.natural_target: N=0 and the equality has Chebyshev mass X/4+o(X)
fixed_target_dichotomy.other_targets: N is a nonzero fixed integer and the prime support is finite
fixed_target_dichotomy.height: log|N| <= m*log(8)+O_(u,v)(1) when N is nonzero

scoped_no_go.method_class: coefficient-only fixed-rational-target arguments on horizontal rays that omit the determinant gate and moving connection target
scoped_no_go.theorem: the natural fixed target has positive Chebyshev mass, while every other fixed rational target is a finite divisor set
closed_methods: universal nonvanishing of c_p on all actual rows
uniform fixed-value o(X) Chebyshev mass for every c_p residue fibre
coefficient-only fixed-target factorization or equidistribution as a substitute for Theta coupling
not_closed: the actual moving affine target c_p=1-epsilon*Theta_(r,s)
average gcd along the fixed-M line

smallest_open_arithmetic_theorem: prove o(M) logarithmic mass for actual fixed-M primes satisfying the old determinant gate and c_p=1-epsilon*Theta_(r,s), with the connection target retained
